fullPassage: All architectural structures are forms of spatial choreography that guides action along predefined pathways. A building shapes how we move, what we see, and whom we encounter. There is a reason, for example, that older universities typically organized classrooms along corridors that fed into larger common areas: the design of the space was _______________. Similarly, traditional office layouts with rows of desks facing a manager's office were not just functional but also symbolic, encoding a particular set of relationships and expectations about supervision and hierarchy. The design of a home, too, tells a story: the size and placement of the kitchen, the presence or absence of a front porch, the separation of public and private spaces — all of these choices reflect and shape patterns of family interaction, hospitality, and individual privacy.

questions.passage: All architectural structures are forms of spatial choreography that guides action along predefined pathways. A building shapes how we move, what we see, and whom we encounter. There is a reason, for example, that older universities typically organized classrooms along corridors that fed into larger common areas: the design of the space was _______________. Similarly, traditional office layouts with rows of desks facing a manager's office were not just functional but also symbolic, encoding a particular set of relationships and expectations about supervision and hierarchy. The design of a home, too, tells a story: the size and placement of the kitchen, the presence or absence of a front porch, the separation of public and private spaces — all of <u>these choices</u> reflect and shape patterns of family interaction, hospitality, and individual privacy.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>these choices</u>가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: these choices는 바로 앞에 나열된 집 설계 요소들(부엌 크기/배치, 현관 유무, 공적/사적 공간 분리)을 가리킴
det.analysis:
❌ ① 외벽 재료와 색상은 본문에 언급되지 않음
✅ ② 바로 앞에 'the size and placement of the kitchen, the presence or absence of a front porch, the separation of public and private spaces'가 나열되고 'all of these choices'로 총칭 ←정답
❌ ③ 사무실 배치는 앞 문장의 내용이지 these choices 직전 내용이 아님
❌ ④ 대학 교실/복도는 더 앞 문장의 내용으로 these choices와 거리가 멀음
det.tip: these choices = 부엌 크기/배치 + 현관 유무 + 공적/사적 공간 분리

ch: 부엌 크기, 현관 유무, 공적/사적 공간 분리 등 집 설계의 결정들
